title: Alchemy and Impurities
titles: A Treatise on Alchemy and Toxicity
text:
Excess or unrelated elemental Qi increases impurity. A small neutral base improves purity and success; too much becomes waste.

A successful pill with purity of 70% or less leaves one alchemy remnant for each complete 10% of lost purity: 70% yields 3, 60% yields 4. Leave two output slots free for the pill and waste. A ruined batch produces 10 remnants.

With this knowledge and the recipe, the cauldron preview shows an estimated purity range.
